description: A message held for a session: one its host had for it while nobody was there to say whether it should go (a subagent's answer after a restart, say).

id.description: Its id, as held takes it.

text.description: What it says: what its agent's sent, as it's sent.

shown.description: What a person's shown of it: the answer itself, or what became of it in a line (still working, an error). Heads show text where it's missing.

at.description: When it was held, epoch seconds.
